trips.route_note: Buses and vans run from Islamabad/Rawalpindi to Murree via the Murree Expressway in about 1.5-2 hours; a taxi or local transport covers the final climb into the hill station.
trips.why: Frequent buses and vans cover the Murree Expressway in about 1.5-2 hours, with local transport for the final climb.
know: Hill station is busiest in summer and on weekends; expect crowds and traffic
Winter snow can close or slow the Murree Expressway
Pack layers; it is noticeably cooler than Islamabad

trips.route_note: Rawalpindi is a short bus, van or taxi ride from Islamabad across the twin-city boundary, with frequent local transport and no long-distance leg.
trips.why: A 19-minute bus ride with frequent local transport drops you right in Saddar, far simpler than driving.
know: Raja Bazaar is liveliest in the morning and closed on some holidays
Frequent vans and buses cross the twin-city boundary all day
Expect heavy traffic around Saddar in the evening
